metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 2018 · Venom
metas.description: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.9 · 2021 · Venom: Let There Be Carnage
metas.description: Eddie Brock attempts to reignite his career by interviewing serial killer Cletus Kasady, who becomes the host of the symbiote Carnage and escapes prison after a failed execution.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.0 · 2024 · Venom: The Last Dance
metas.description: Eddie Brock and Venom must make a devastating decision as they're pursued by a mysterious military man and alien monsters from Venom's home world.
